name: claude-art-pipeline
description: aj's art-pipeline plugin for Claude Code.

plugins.name: art-pipeline
plugins.description: Make game art by code - models, animation, VFX, SFX, music, textures, sprites, UI art. Nothing is made until a human approves a spec with real-world reference, each approval has a build budget, and a model is not done until it is looked at beside its concept. Hooks enforce all three.
